title: NSP Delegation Envelope
description: Harness-neutral parent-to-sub-agent entry contract. When NSP_ENTRY_MODE is delegated, the child must skip top-level genesis, broad routing, persona discovery, and epic ownership.

EPIC_OWNER.description: Primary/coordinating agent identity or label. Delegated agents must not become epic owners.

CONTEXT_POLICY.description: Delegates must not ingest parent chat history. Use only this envelope, REQUIRED_CONTEXT, and path-local safety guidance.

EFFORT_CLASS.description: Optional harness-owned effort hint. Prefer lowest-sufficient for mechanical implement/validate slices when available. Not a model or provider identity.

SEPARATION.description: Optional role separation for this delegate. Prefer distinct implement vs validate/adversarial-review agents when the harness supports fresh context.

DO_NOT.description: Explicit prohibitions. defaults include no re-genesis, no re-routing, no new epic.
